name: Red in Tooth and Claw
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target grows vicious teeth and claws. If the target did not have a bite attack or claws, they gain a 1d4 bite and two 1d4 claw attack for a medium creature. If the creature already had one of the added natural attacks, it instead increases the dice damage of that natural attack up by one step. The target can make a full attack with all three natural attacks without taking a penalty for multi-weapon fighting, however, if they use one of the natural attacks in conjunction with manufactured weapon attacks, they take a -5 penalty. Additionally, you gain a +4 bonus on Intimidate checks.

Red in Tooth and Claw, Mass

School transmutation; Level druid 3

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as red in tooth and claw except it affects multiple creatures.
